questions.question: How many people are in the dataset?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many parties are there?

queries.typeql: match $p isa party; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Party) RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many candidacies are there in total?

queries.typeql: match $c isa candidacy; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidacy;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy) RETURN count(c)

questions.question: How many people recorded a favourite biscuit?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person, has favourite_biscuit $b; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE favourite_biscuit IS NOT NULL;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.favourite_biscuit IS NOT NULL RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many candidacies resulted in the candidate being elected?

queries.typeql: match $c isa candidacy, has elected true; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true RETURN count(c)

questions.question: How many ballots were by-elections?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot, has by_election true; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ballot WHERE by_election = true;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot) WHERE b.by_election = true RETURN count(b)

questions.question: What is the total number of votes cast across all candidacies?

queries.typeql: match $c isa candidacy, has votes_cast $v; reduce $sum = sum($v);
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(votes_cast) FROM candidacy;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy) RETURN sum(c.votes_cast)

questions.question: What is the total number of spoilt ballots across all ballots?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot, has spoilt_ballots $s; reduce $sum = sum($s);
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(spoilt_ballots) FROM ballot;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot) RETURN sum(b.spoilt_ballots)

questions.question: What is the highest number of votes cast for a single candidacy?

queries.typeql: match $c isa candidacy, has votes_cast $v; reduce $max = max($v);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(votes_cast) FROM candidacy;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy) RETURN max(c.votes_cast)

questions.question: Has any candidacy been won on a tied vote?

queries.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidacy WHERE tied_vote_winner = true);
queries.cypher: RETURN EXISTS { MATCH (c:Candidacy) WHERE c.tied_vote_winner = true }

questions.question: Which party won the most seats, counting only candidacies where the candidate was elected?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa), has elected true; reduce $n = count groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id WHERE c.elected = true GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which post had the highest total electorate in any single ballot?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot, has total_electorate $te; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); $po has post_label $label; sort $te desc; limit 1; select $label;
queries.sql: SELECT po.post_label FROM ballot b JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE b.total_electorate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.total_electorate DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post) WHERE b.total_electorate IS NOT NULL RETURN po.post_label ORDER BY b.total_electorate DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the top three parties by number of candidacies, most first?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 3; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: For the party with the most candidacies, what is its name and how many candidacies did it field? Count different parties with the same name separately.

queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name AS party, COUNT(*) AS candidacies FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY candidacies DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WITH p, count(c) AS candidacies RETURN p.party_name AS party, candidacies ORDER BY candidacies DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many ballots were held for the 2024 general election?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $b isa ballot; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $count = count($b);
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ballot WHERE election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04';
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'}) RETURN count(b)

questions.question: Which organisation has held the most ballots?

queries.typeql: match $o isa organisation, has organisation_name $name; $b isa ballot; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); reduce $n = count($b) groupby $o, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT organisation_name FROM ballot WHERE organisation_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organisation_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation) WITH o, count(b) AS n RETURN o.organisation_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many distinct people have been elected?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p), has elected true; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: Is there any candidate who was elected without any recorded votes?

queries.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true AND votes_cast IS NULL);
queries.cypher: RETURN EXISTS { MATCH (c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true AND c.votes_cast IS NULL }

questions.question: How many people have stood for the Labour Party in a by-election?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name "Labour Party"; $b isa ballot, has by_election true; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa, ballot: $b); reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE p.party_name = 'Labour Party' AND b.by_election = true;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(:Party {party_name: 'Labour Party'}), (c)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot) WHERE b.by_election = true RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many people were elected in more than one ballot?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p), has elected true; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT person_id FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true GROUP BY person_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS wins WHERE wins > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many people have stood as candidates in more than one distinct election?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $p, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH p, count(DISTINCT e) AS elections WHERE elections > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many people have been elected to more than one distinct organisation?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b), has elected true; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); reduce $x = count groupby $p, $o; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.organisation_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.organisation_name) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(DISTINCT o) AS orgs WHERE orgs > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood for election in Scotland?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.person_id) FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 = 'Scotland';
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post {nuts1: 'Scotland'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many distinct parties have fielded a candidate in Wales?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Wales"; $pa isa party; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $pa; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.party_id) FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 = 'Wales';
queries.cypher: MATCH (:Post {nuts1: 'Wales'})<-[:FOR_POST]-(:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) RETURN count(DISTINCT pa)

questions.question: What is the greatest number of distinct people to stand as candidates in a single election?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election; $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $e, $p; reduce $n = count groupby $e; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT b.election_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) AS cnt FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY b.election_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH e, count(DISTINCT p) AS cnt RETURN max(cnt)

questions.question: How many parties never had a candidate elected?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party; not { $_ isa candidacy, links (party: $pa), has elected true; }; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidacy c WHERE c.party_id = p.party_id AND c.elected = true);
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Party) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p) WHERE c.elected = true } RETURN count(p)

questions.question: What is the largest number of candidates standing in a single ballot?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $b; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT ballot_paper_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM candidacy GROUP BY ballot_paper_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot) WITH b, count(c) AS cnt RETURN max(cnt)

questions.question: Which party won the most seats in the 2024 general election?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the greatest number of distinct elections that any single post has been contested in?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $po, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $po; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT b.post_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) AS n FROM ballot b GROUP BY b.post_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH po, count(DISTINCT e) AS n RETURN max(n)

questions.question: Which organisation, other than the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, has returned the most elected representatives?

queries.typeql: match $o isa organisation, has organisation_name $name; $name != "House of Commons of the United Kingdom"; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has elected true; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $o, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT b.organisation_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.organisation_name IS NOT NULL AND b.organisation_name <> 'House of Commons of the United Kingdom' GROUP BY b.organisation_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation) WHERE c.elected = true AND o.organisation_name <> 'House of Commons of the United Kingdom' WITH o, count(c) AS n RETURN o.organisation_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What's the ID of the election that had the most distinct parties standing?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id $eid; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $eid, $pa; reduce $n = count groupby $eid; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $eid;
queries.sql: SELECT b.election_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY b.election_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.party_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH e, count(DISTINCT pa) AS n RETURN e.election_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which party has won the most seats in Scotland?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id JOIN party p ON ca.party_id = p.party_id WHERE ca.elected = true AND po.nuts1 = 'Scotland' GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post {nuts1: 'Scotland'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: In which region have the most candidacies been contested?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 $region; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $region; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $region;
queries.sql: SELECT po.nuts1 FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY po.nuts1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post) WHERE po.nuts1 IS NOT NULL WITH po.nuts1 AS region, count(*) AS n RETURN region ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many people have stood for the 'Scottish National Party (SNP)' in a Scottish constituency?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name "Scottish National Party (SNP)"; $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE p.party_name = 'Scottish National Party (SNP)' AND po.nuts1 = 'Scotland';
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(:Party {party_name: 'Scottish National Party (SNP)'}), (c)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post {nuts1: 'Scotland'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many people stood as candidates in both the 2019 and the 2024 general elections (IDs parl.2019-12-12 and parl.2024-07-04)?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c1 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b1); at_election (ballot: $b1, election: $e1); $e1 has election_id "parl.2019-12-12"; $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b2); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id IN ('parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04') GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) = 2) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WHERE e.election_id IN ['parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04'] WITH p, count(DISTINCT e) AS elections WHERE elections = 2 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: In how many constituencies did the winning party change between the 2015 and the 2019 general elections (IDs parl.2015-05-07 and parl.2019-12-12)?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; $c1 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b1, party: $pa1), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b1, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b1, election: $e1); $e1 has election_id "parl.2015-05-07"; $c2 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b2, party: $pa2), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b2, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 has election_id "parl.2019-12-12"; not { $pa1 is $pa2; }; reduce $x = count groupby $po; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.post_id, c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id = 'parl.2015-05-07') w15 JOIN (SELECT b.post_id, c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id = 'parl.2019-12-12') w19 ON w15.post_id = w19.post_id WHERE w15.party_id <> w19.party_id;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p15:Party)<-[:FOR_PARTY]-(c15:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b15:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2015-05-07'}), (b15)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post) WHERE c15.elected = true MATCH (p19:Party)<-[:FOR_PARTY]-(c19:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b19:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2019-12-12'}), (b19)-[:FOR_POST]->(po) WHERE c19.elected = true AND p15 <> p19 RETURN count(DISTINCT po)

questions.question: What is the greatest number of distinct parties to have won any single post across all elections?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $po, $pa; reduce $n = count groupby $po; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT b.post_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.party_id) AS n FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true GROUP BY b.post_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH po, count(DISTINCT pa) AS n RETURN max(n)

questions.question: How many people have been elected for more than one distinct party?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa), has elected true; reduce $x = count groupby $p, $pa; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT person_id FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true GROUP BY person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT party_id) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(DISTINCT pa) AS parties WHERE parties > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: Which party has fielded candidates in the greatest number of distinct elections?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $pa, $name, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WITH p, count(DISTINCT e) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: At the 2024 general election (election ID parl.2024-07-04), in how many ballots did the elected candidate receive less than 40% of all the votes cast in that ballot?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $b isa ballot; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $w isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has elected true, has votes_cast $wv; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has votes_cast $v; reduce $total = sum($v) groupby $b, $wv; match let $share = $wv * 100; let $bar = $total * 40; $share < $bar; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH tot AS (SELECT c.ballot_paper_id, SUM(c.votes_cast) AS total FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' GROUP BY c.ballot_paper_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tot JOIN candidacy w ON w.ballot_paper_id = tot.ballot_paper_id WHERE w.elected = true AND w.votes_cast * 100 < tot.total * 40;
queries.cypher: MATCH (:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'})<-[:AT_ELECTION]-(b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy) WITH b, sum(c.votes_cast) AS total MATCH (b)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(w:Candidacy) WHERE w.elected = true AND w.votes_cast * 100 < total * 40 RETURN count(*)

questions.question: At the 2024 general election (election ID parl.2024-07-04), what is the smallest margin of victory in any ballot, where the margin is the elected candidate's votes minus the highest votes cast for any other candidate in the same ballot?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $b isa ballot; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $w isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has elected true, has votes_cast $wv; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has votes_cast $v; not { $c is $w; }; reduce $runner = max($v) groupby $b, $wv; match let $margin = $wv - $runner; reduce $min = min($margin);
queries.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT c.ballot_paper_id, c.votes_cast AS v FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' AND c.elected = true), r AS (SELECT c.ballot_paper_id, MAX(c.votes_cast) AS v FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' AND c.elected IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY c.ballot_paper_id) SELECT MIN(w.v - r.v) FROM w JOIN r ON w.ballot_paper_id = r.ballot_paper_id;
queries.cypher: MATCH (:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'})<-[:AT_ELECTION]-(b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(w:Candidacy) WHERE w.elected = true MATCH (b)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy) WHERE c <> w WITH b, w.votes_cast AS wv, max(c.votes_cast) AS runner RETURN min(wv - runner)

questions.question: How many people were elected at the 2015 general election (parl.2015-05-07), stood again for the same post at the 2019 general election (parl.2019-12-12), and were not elected that time?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $po isa post; $c1 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b1), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b1, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b1, election: $e1); $e1 has election_id "parl.2015-05-07"; $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b2), has elected false; for_post (ballot: $b2, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 has election_id "parl.2019-12-12"; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.person_id) FROM (SELECT c.person_id, b.post_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2015-05-07' AND c.elected = true) w JOIN (SELECT c.person_id, b.post_id, c.elected FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2019-12-12') s ON s.person_id = w.person_id AND s.post_id = w.post_id WHERE s.elected = false;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c1:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b1:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2015-05-07'}), (b1)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post) WHERE c1.elected = true MATCH (p)-[:STOOD]->(c2:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b2:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2019-12-12'}), (b2)-[:FOR_POST]->(po) WHERE c2.elected = false RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: Counting only posts for which at least five different ballots have produced an elected candidate, how many of those posts have had every elected candidate come from the same party?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); not { $c2 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b2, party: $pa2), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b2, post: $po); not { $pa2 is $pa; }; }; reduce $x = count groupby $po, $b; reduce $n = count groupby $po; match $n >= 5; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.post_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true GROUP BY b.post_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.ballot_paper_id) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.party_id) = 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH po, count(DISTINCT b) AS ballots, count(DISTINCT pa) AS parties WHERE ballots >= 5 AND parties = 1 RETURN count(po)

questions.question: For each region (the nuts1 value of a post), which party has won the most elected candidacies in that region? Return one row per region.

queries.typeql: with fun top_party($r: nuts1) -> party_name: match $po isa post, has nuts1 $r; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); $pa has party_name $pn; reduce $n = count groupby $pn; sort $n desc; limit 1; return first $pn; match $po isa post, has nuts1 $region; reduce $x = count groupby $region; match let $party in top_party($region); fetch { "region": $region, "party": $party };
queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT po.nuts1 AS region, pa.party_name AS party, COUNT(*) AS n FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id JOIN party pa ON c.party_id = pa.party_id WHERE c.elected = true GROUP BY po.nuts1, pa.party_name) SELECT region, party FROM s WHERE (region, n) IN (SELECT region, MAX(n) FROM s GROUP BY region);
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH po.nuts1 AS region, pa.party_name AS party, count(c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC WITH region, collect(party)[0] AS party RETURN region, party
queries.dummy: [{"region": "East Midlands (England)", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"region": "East of England", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"region": "London", "party": "Labour Party"}, {"region": "North East (England)", "party": "Labour Party"}, {"region": "North West (England)", "party": "Labour Party"}, {"region": "Northern Ireland", "party": "Democratic Unionist Party - D.U.P."}, {"region": "Scotland", "party": "Scottish National Party (SNP)"}, {"region": "South East (England)", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"region": "South West (England)", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"region": "Wales", "party": "Labour Party"}, {"region": "West Midlands (England)", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"region": "Yorkshire and The Humber", "party": "Labour Party"}]

questions.question: How many people were elected in at least one candidacy at the earliest election date on which they ever stood?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e has election_date $d; reduce $first = min($d) groupby $p; match $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b2), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 has election_date == $first; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH pe AS (SELECT c.person_id, e.election_date, c.elected FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON b.election_id = e.election_id), f AS (SELECT person_id, MIN(election_date) AS d FROM pe GROUP BY person_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe.person_id) FROM pe JOIN f ON pe.person_id = f.person_id AND pe.election_date = f.d WHERE pe.elected = true;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH p, min(e.election_date) AS first MATCH (p)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e2:Election) WHERE c.elected = true AND e2.election_date = first RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: Of the posts contested at both the 2015 (parl.2015-05-07) and the 2019 (parl.2019-12-12) general elections, in how many did exactly the same set of parties field candidates at both elections?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; $b15 isa ballot; for_post (ballot: $b15, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b15, election: $e15); $e15 has election_id "parl.2015-05-07"; $b19 isa ballot; for_post (ballot: $b19, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b19, election: $e19); $e19 has election_id "parl.2019-12-12"; not { $c1 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b15, party: $pa1); not { $c2 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b19, party: $pa1); }; }; not { $c3 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b19, party: $pa2); not { $c4 isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b15, party: $pa2); }; }; reduce $x = count groupby $po; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH p15 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.post_id, c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2015-05-07'), p19 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.post_id, c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2019-12-12'), shared AS (SELECT post_id FROM p15 INTERSECT SELECT post_id FROM p19) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT party_id FROM p15 WHERE p15.post_id = s.post_id EXCEPT SELECT party_id FROM p19 WHERE p19.post_id = s.post_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT party_id FROM p19 WHERE p19.post_id = s.post_id EXCEPT SELECT party_id FROM p15 WHERE p15.post_id = s.post_id);
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WHERE e.election_id IN ['parl.2015-05-07', 'parl.2019-12-12'] MATCH (b)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH po, e.election_id AS eid, collect(DISTINCT pa.party_id) AS parties WITH po, collect(parties) AS sets WHERE size(sets) = 2 AND size(sets[0]) = size(sets[1]) AND all(x IN sets[0] WHERE x IN sets[1]) RETURN count(po)

questions.question: How many people stood for one party at a parliamentary election and then for a different party at the next parliamentary election in which they stood?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c1 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b1, party: $pa1); at_election (ballot: $b1, election: $e1); $e1 isa parliamentary_election, has election_date $d1; $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b2, party: $pa2); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 isa parliamentary_election, has election_date $d2; $d1 < $d2; not { $pa1 is $pa2; }; not { $c3 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b3); at_election (ballot: $b3, election: $e3); $e3 isa parliamentary_election, has election_date $d3; $d3 > $d1; $d3 < $d2; }; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id, e.election_date, c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON b.election_id = e.election_id WHERE e.kind = 'parliamentary_election'), ord AS (SELECT person_id, party_id, LAG(party_id) OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY election_date) AS prev FROM pc) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM ord WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND prev <> party_id;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party), (c)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:ParliamentaryElection) WITH DISTINCT p, e.election_date AS d, pa.party_id AS party WITH p, d, party ORDER BY d WITH p, collect(party) AS ps WHERE any(i IN range(0, size(ps) - 2) WHERE ps[i] <> ps[i + 1]) RETURN count(p)

questions.question: In how many ballots contesting more than one seat did a single party win every seat contested?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot, has seats_contested $s; $s > 1; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; reduce $won = count groupby $b, $pa, $s; match $won == $s; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.ballot_paper_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.seats_contested > 1 GROUP BY c.ballot_paper_id, c.party_id, b.seats_contested HAVING COUNT(*) = b.seats_contested) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE b.seats_contested > 1 AND c.elected = true WITH b, pa, count(c) AS won WHERE won = b.seats_contested RETURN count(*)

questions.question: How many parties fielded at least one candidate at every one of the five parliamentary general elections parl.2010-05-06, parl.2015-05-07, parl.2017-06-08, parl.2019-12-12 and parl.2024-07-04?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e has election_id $id; { $id == "parl.2010-05-06"; } or { $id == "parl.2015-05-07"; } or { $id == "parl.2017-06-08"; } or { $id == "parl.2019-12-12"; } or { $id == "parl.2024-07-04"; }; reduce $x = count groupby $pa, $id; reduce $n = count groupby $pa; match $n == 5; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.party_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE b.election_id IN ('parl.2010-05-06', 'parl.2015-05-07', 'parl.2017-06-08', 'parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04') GROUP BY c.party_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) = 5) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (pa:Party)<-[:FOR_PARTY]-(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WHERE e.election_id IN ['parl.2010-05-06', 'parl.2015-05-07', 'parl.2017-06-08', 'parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04'] WITH pa, count(DISTINCT e) AS n WHERE n = 5 RETURN count(pa)

questions.question: How many people have stood in at least five parliamentary candidacies (candidacies in ballots at parliamentary elections) without ever having been elected in any contest?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; not { $c0 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p), has elected true; }; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e isa parliamentary_election; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n >= 5; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON e.election_id = b.election_id WHERE e.kind = 'parliamentary_election' GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidacy c2 WHERE c2.person_id = t.person_id AND c2.elected = true);
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:ParliamentaryElection) WITH p, count(c) AS n WHERE n >= 5 AND NOT EXISTS { (p)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy {elected: true}) } RETURN count(p)

questions.question: Starting from the Scottish National Party (SNP) and following defections from one party to the next, how many other parties can be reached in one or more steps?

queries.typeql: with fun reaches($p: party) -> { party }: match { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $q); } or { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $mid); let $q in reaches($mid); }; return { $q }; match $s isa party, has party_name "Scottish National Party (SNP)"; let $r in reaches($s); not { $r is $s; }; reduce $x = count groupby $r; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reach AS (SELECT d.to_party_id AS node FROM defection d JOIN party p ON p.party_id = d.from_party_id WHERE p.party_name = 'Scottish National Party (SNP)' UNION SELECT d.to_party_id FROM reach r JOIN defection d ON d.from_party_id = r.node) SELECT count(*) FROM reach WHERE node <> (SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_name = 'Scottish National Party (SNP)');
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Party {party_name: 'Scottish National Party (SNP)'})-[:DEFECTED_TO*1..]->(p:Party) WHERE p <> s RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: Starting from Gwlad, how many other parties can be reached by following at most two defections?

queries.typeql: match $g isa party, has party_name "Gwlad"; { defection (from_party: $g, to_party: $r); } or { defection (from_party: $g, to_party: $mid); defection (from_party: $mid, to_party: $r); }; not { $r is $g; }; reduce $x = count groupby $r; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE steps AS (SELECT party_id AS node, 0 AS depth FROM party WHERE party_name = 'Gwlad' UNION ALL SELECT d.to_party_id, s.depth + 1 FROM steps s JOIN defection d ON d.from_party_id = s.node WHERE s.depth < 2) SELECT count(DISTINCT node) FROM steps WHERE depth > 0 AND node <> (SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_name = 'Gwlad');
queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Party {party_name: 'Gwlad'})-[:DEFECTED_TO*1..2]->(p:Party) WHERE p <> g RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many defection links lie on the shortest chain of defections leading from 'Abolish The Welsh Assembly Party' to 'Trade Unionist and Socialist Coalition'? Count the links in the chain, not the people who defected along it.

queries.typeql: with fun steps($a: party, $b: party, $budget: integer) -> { integer }: match { defection (from_party: $a, to_party: $b); let $n = 1; } or { $budget > 1; defection (from_party: $a, to_party: $mid); let $rem = $budget - 1; let $m in steps($mid, $b, $rem); let $n = $m + 1; }; return { $n }; match $a isa party, has party_name "Abolish The Welsh Assembly Party"; $b isa party, has party_name "Trade Unionist and Socialist Coalition"; let $n in steps($a, $b, 8); reduce $min = min($n);
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk AS (SELECT party_id AS node, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[party_id] AS seen FROM party WHERE party_name = 'Abolish The Welsh Assembly Party' UNION ALL SELECT d.to_party_id, w.depth + 1, w.seen || d.to_party_id FROM walk w JOIN defection d ON d.from_party_id = w.node WHERE NOT d.to_party_id = ANY(w.seen)) SELECT min(depth) FROM walk w JOIN party p ON p.party_id = w.node WHERE p.party_name = 'Trade Unionist and Socialist Coalition';
queries.cypher: MATCH path = shortestPath((a:Party {party_name: 'Abolish The Welsh Assembly Party'})-[:DEFECTED_TO*1..]->(b:Party {party_name: 'Trade Unionist and Socialist Coalition'})) RETURN length(path)

questions.question: From how many other parties can 'Independent' be reached by following one or more defections?

queries.typeql: with fun reaches($p: party) -> { party }: match { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $q); } or { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $mid); let $q in reaches($mid); }; return { $q }; match $t isa party, has party_name "Independent"; $p isa party; let $r in reaches($p); $r is $t; not { $p is $t; }; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE back AS (SELECT d.from_party_id AS node FROM defection d JOIN party p ON p.party_id = d.to_party_id WHERE p.party_name = 'Independent' UNION SELECT d.from_party_id FROM back b JOIN defection d ON d.to_party_id = b.node) SELECT count(*) FROM back WHERE node <> (SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_name = 'Independent');
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Party)-[:DEFECTED_TO*1..]->(t:Party {party_name: 'Independent'}) WHERE p <> t RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many parties can return to themselves by following one or more defections?

queries.typeql: with fun reaches($p: party) -> { party }: match { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $q); } or { defection (from_party: $p, to_party: $mid); let $q in reaches($mid); }; return { $q }; match $p isa party; let $r in reaches($p); $r is $p; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reach AS (SELECT from_party_id AS root, to_party_id AS node FROM defection UNION SELECT r.root, d.to_party_id FROM reach r JOIN defection d ON d.from_party_id = r.node) SELECT count(DISTINCT root) FROM reach WHERE root = node;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Party) WHERE EXISTS { (p)-[:DEFECTED_TO*1..]->(p) } RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood for the same party at the same post in two different elections?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $pa isa party; $po isa post; $c1 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa, ballot: $b1); for_post (ballot: $b1, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b1, election: $e1); $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa, ballot: $b2); for_post (ballot: $b2, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); not { $e1 is $e2; }; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c1.person_id FROM candidacy c1 JOIN ballot b1 ON b1.ballot_paper_id = c1.ballot_paper_id JOIN candidacy c2 ON c2.person_id = c1.person_id AND c2.party_id = c1.party_id JOIN ballot b2 ON b2.ballot_paper_id = c2.ballot_paper_id AND b2.post_id = b1.post_id WHERE b1.election_id <> b2.election_id GROUP BY c1.person_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c1:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party), (c1)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b1:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post), (b1)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e1:Election), (p)-[:STOOD]->(c2:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa), (c2)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b2:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po), (b2)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e2:Election) WHERE e1 <> e2 RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood for at least two different parties at the same post?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $po isa post; $c1 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa1, ballot: $b1); for_post (ballot: $b1, post: $po); $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa2, ballot: $b2); for_post (ballot: $b2, post: $po); not { $pa1 is $pa2; }; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c1.person_id FROM candidacy c1 JOIN ballot b1 ON b1.ballot_paper_id = c1.ballot_paper_id JOIN candidacy c2 ON c2.person_id = c1.person_id JOIN ballot b2 ON b2.ballot_paper_id = c2.ballot_paper_id AND b2.post_id = b1.post_id WHERE c1.party_id <> c2.party_id GROUP BY c1.person_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c1:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa1:Party), (c1)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b1:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post), (p)-[:STOOD]->(c2:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa2:Party), (c2)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b2:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po) WHERE pa1 <> pa2 RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: Which party has the most candidacies in which the candidate was elected with more than 20,000 votes? Return the party's name.

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa), has elected true, has votes_cast $v; $v > 20000; reduce $n = count groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON p.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.elected = true AND c.votes_cast > 20000 GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true AND c.votes_cast > 20000 WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: In how many ballots did two or more candidates stand for the same party?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot; $pa isa party; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa); reduce $n = count groupby $b, $pa; match $n >= 2; reduce $x = count groupby $b; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ballot_paper_id) FROM (SELECT ballot_paper_id, party_id FROM candidacy GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)<-[:IN_BALLOT]-(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH b, pa, count(c) AS n WHERE n >= 2 RETURN count(DISTINCT b)

questions.question: Which person has stood for the greatest number of distinct parties? Return that person's name and the number of parties. Count people by their person record, since different people can share a name.

queries.typeql: match $p isa person, has person_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa); reduce $x = count groupby $p, $name, $pa; reduce $parties = count groupby $p, $name; sort $parties desc; limit 1; fetch { "person": $name, "parties": $parties };
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_name AS person, COUNT(DISTINCT c.party_id) AS parties FROM candidacy c JOIN person p ON p.person_id = c.person_id GROUP BY p.person_id, p.person_name ORDER BY parties DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH p, count(DISTINCT pa) AS parties RETURN p.person_name AS person, parties ORDER BY parties DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which organisation has held ballots at the greatest number of distinct elections? Return its name.

queries.typeql: match $o isa organisation, has organisation_name $name; $b isa ballot; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $o, $name, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $o, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT organisation_name FROM ballot GROUP BY organisation_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT election_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation), (b)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH o, count(DISTINCT e) AS n RETURN o.organisation_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many posts have been contested at more than eight distinct elections?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; $b isa ballot; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $po, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $po; match $n > 8; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT post_id FROM ballot GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT election_id) > 8) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (b:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post), (b)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH po, count(DISTINCT e) AS n WHERE n > 8 RETURN count(po)

questions.question: Which person has been elected the most times? Return that person's name and the number of times. Count people by their person record, since different people can share a name.

queries.typeql: match $p isa person, has person_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p), has elected true; reduce $times = count groupby $p, $name; sort $times desc; limit 1; fetch { "person": $name, "times": $times };
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_name AS person, COUNT(*) AS times FROM candidacy c JOIN person p ON p.person_id = c.person_id WHERE c.elected = true GROUP BY p.person_id, p.person_name ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS times RETURN p.person_name AS person, times ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For each of the five parliamentary general elections (parl.2010-05-06, parl.2015-05-07, parl.2017-06-08, parl.2019-12-12 and parl.2024-07-04), which party won the most seats? Return one row per election.

queries.typeql: with fun top_party($e: election) -> party_name: match $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $pa has party_name $pn; reduce $n = count groupby $pn; sort $n desc; limit 1; return first $pn; match $e isa election, has election_id $id; { $id == "parl.2010-05-06"; } or { $id == "parl.2015-05-07"; } or { $id == "parl.2017-06-08"; } or { $id == "parl.2019-12-12"; } or { $id == "parl.2024-07-04"; }; let $party in top_party($e); fetch { "election": $id, "party": $party };
queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT b.election_id, pa.party_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN party pa ON pa.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id IN ('parl.2010-05-06', 'parl.2015-05-07', 'parl.2017-06-08', 'parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT election_id AS election, party_name AS party FROM s WHERE (election_id, n) IN (SELECT election_id, MAX(n) FROM s GROUP BY 1);
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true AND e.election_id IN ['parl.2010-05-06', 'parl.2015-05-07', 'parl.2017-06-08', 'parl.2019-12-12', 'parl.2024-07-04'] WITH e.election_id AS election, pa.party_name AS party, count(c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC WITH election, collect(party)[0] AS party RETURN election, party
queries.dummy: [{"election": "parl.2010-05-06", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"election": "parl.2015-05-07", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"election": "parl.2017-06-08", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"election": "parl.2019-12-12", "party": "Conservative and Unionist Party"}, {"election": "parl.2024-07-04", "party": "Labour Party"}]

questions.question: Which party won the second-most seats at the 2024 general election (parl.2024-07-04)? Return its name.

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b, party: $pa), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $pa has party_name $name; reduce $n = count groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; offset 1; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT pa.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN party pa ON pa.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' GROUP BY pa.party_id, pa.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH pa, count(c) AS n RETURN pa.party_name ORDER BY n DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among parties that have fielded at least 100 candidacies, which has the highest share of its candidacies that resulted in the candidate being elected? Return its name.

queries.typeql: with fun stood($pa: party) -> integer: match $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa); return count; with fun won($pa: party) -> integer: match $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa), has elected true; return count; match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; let $s in stood($pa); $s >= 100; let $w in won($pa); let $share = 1.0 * $w / $s; sort $share desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT pa.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN party pa ON pa.party_id = c.party_id GROUP BY pa.party_id, pa.party_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.elected = true) / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH pa, count(c) AS stood, count(CASE WHEN c.elected = true THEN 1 END) AS won WHERE stood >= 100 RETURN pa.party_name ORDER BY 1.0 * won / stood DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For the party that won the most seats at the 2024 general election (parl.2024-07-04), return its name, how many candidacies it fielded there, and how many of those resulted in the candidate being elected.

queries.typeql: with fun won_2024($pa: party) -> integer: match $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; return count; match $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; reduce $candidacies = count groupby $pa, $name; match let $elected in won_2024($pa); sort $elected desc; limit 1; fetch { "party": $name, "candidacies": $candidacies, "elected": $elected };
queries.sql: SELECT pa.party_name AS party, COUNT(*) AS candidacies, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.elected = true) AS elected FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN party pa ON pa.party_id = c.party_id WHERE b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' GROUP BY pa.party_id, pa.party_name ORDER BY elected DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH pa, count(c) AS candidacies, count(CASE WHEN c.elected = true THEN 1 END) AS elected ORDER BY elected DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN pa.party_name AS party, candidacies, elected

questions.question: How many devolved elections have there been?

queries.typeql: match $e isa devolved_election; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE k AS (SELECT kind FROM election_kind WHERE kind = 'devolved_election' UNION SELECT ek.kind FROM election_kind ek JOIN k ON ek.parent_kind = k.kind) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM election WHERE kind IN (SELECT kind FROM k);
queries.cypher: MATCH (e:DevolvedElection) RETURN count(e)

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood as candidates at local elections of any kind?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e isa local_election; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE k AS (SELECT kind FROM election_kind WHERE kind = 'local_election' UNION SELECT ek.kind FROM election_kind ek JOIN k ON ek.parent_kind = k.kind) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON e.election_id = b.election_id WHERE e.kind IN (SELECT kind FROM k);
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:LocalElection) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood at a devolved election but never at a parliamentary election?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); $e isa devolved_election; not { $c2 isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b2); at_election (ballot: $b2, election: $e2); $e2 isa parliamentary_election; }; reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE k AS (SELECT kind FROM election_kind WHERE kind = 'devolved_election' UNION SELECT ek.kind FROM election_kind ek JOIN k ON ek.parent_kind = k.kind) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON e.election_id = b.election_id WHERE e.kind IN (SELECT kind FROM k) EXCEPT SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON b.ballot_paper_id = c.ballot_paper_id JOIN election e ON e.election_id = b.election_id WHERE e.kind = 'parliamentary_election') t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:DevolvedElection) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (p)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:ParliamentaryElection) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p)
